title: British Fish & Chips
description: A classic British dish featuring battered fish, crispy chips, and a side of malt vinegar.

ingredients.name: Cod Fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh cod fillets are best for this recipe.

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pan to 350°F (180°C).
Prepare the batter according to the package instructions.
Dust the cod fillets with flour.
Dip the floured cod in the batter, coating evenly.
Carefully place the battered cod in the hot oil.
Fry for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the cod from the oil with a slotted spoon.
Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C) for frying the chips.
Cut the chips into 1/2-inch thick sticks.
Fry the chips in batches until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the chips on paper towels.
Serve the battered fish with chips, malt vinegar, and a squeeze of lemon.
